sections.markdown:
## G - Definition of Done Matrix, Chapter Five Intersections and turns

DoD dispositions for the merged Chapter Five dossier. Domains covered: the Intersections and turns domain carries every Chapter Five rule in part C. Passing standard: part A records it as unknown with no asserted value. High-yield ranked lists: present for the Intersections and turns domain in parts C and C2. Misconceptions: covered as confusable pairs with stated differences in part C2. Mnemonics: not applicable, since the handbook chapter holds no field mnemonics. Glossary: key terms defined inline across part C fact blocks. Dynamic isolation: part D records dated facts riding with cited pages, so nothing required separate isolation. Competitive teardown and market pack: recorded as scoped dispositions in parts E2 and E. Accuracy and verify list: attested in parts D and F.
